actions.acceptance: Given 0.2.0-waitlist receives canary traffic, when requests are processed, then error_rate remains within the allowed threshold (delta <= 0.010).
actions.problem: Canary release 0.2.0-waitlist fails 100% of incoming requests upon deployment.
actions.title: Fix waitlist service endpoint failures on canary

causes.cause: Canary release 0.2.0-waitlist experienced a 100% error rate upon receiving traffic at stage 5%.
causes.evidence: log:4 shows slo: error_rate canary(0.2.0-waitlist)=1.000 while stable(0.1.0-m2)=no data

timeline.event: Stable confirmed at 0.1.0-m2 and release 0.2.0-waitlist initiated.
Release 0.2.0-waitlist deployed to staging using image lights-out-backend@sha256:ab76e8057597500f4c290834014aba7e5031bea11938076cd516f8bef16eaacc.
Canary reached 5% traffic and breached error rate SLO with verdict NO-GO.
Alert fired for SLO breach on error_rate canary(0.2.0-waitlist)=1.000 exceeding delta max 0.010.

args.title: Postmortem: 0.2.0-waitlist canary rollback on 100% error rate
